metadata.name: bordrless_companion
metadata.description: Bordrless companions: a launch's creator is a program, so its creator fees are bought back and burned, streamed to holders or vested to its launcher by code, every step permissionless. Reward and buyback tokens with no keeper and no backend to trust.

instructions.name: burn_stranded
docs: Anyone: burns as SOL a blocked game hook's buyback that no buyback has spent or waited on
for 30 days (the pot with it), paying nobody.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it (paid nothing).

instructions.name: buyback
docs: Anyone: buys the token back with the pending buyback (capped, spaced) and burns it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Anyone: claims the creator fees and splits them.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: claim_prize
docs: Anyone: pays the draw's winner for attempt `attempt`, during its window.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

accounts.name: holding
docs: of this mint, at its owner's address.

instructions.name: create
docs: Makes a companion for `mint` (not created yet): the split, the bounty, the buyback limits,
the vesting; funds its creator address and creates its bridged-SOL holding.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, a fresh keypair: it signs here, so only whoever holds it can make its
companion (nobody can make one first and become its beneficiary), and the launch later.

instructions.name: create_game
docs: Makes the companion's game for `mint` (not launched yet; the mint signs): the pot's part of
the split, the hook (prepared for the mint), the rounds, the minimum pot, the prize, the
claim windows.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint (not created yet): it signs, as for `create`, so only whoever holds it
makes its game.

accounts.name: hook_state
docs: `PDA(["state", mint], hook)`, magic, mint).

accounts.name: hook_registry
docs: `PDA(["bordrless-hook-accounts", mint], hook)`): the extra accounts a launch carries.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: must exist, and not block the hook, for any hook but Bordrless's lottery hook.

instructions.name: dev_buy
docs: The beneficiary's buy, held by the companion and vesting to them.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Anyone: once `round` is over, commits its draw's seed, made from `slot` (one of the last
three slots), and asks the oracle for it, the pot paying (or adopts a pending request for
it), in one instruction; or rolls the round over: no tickets, too late, or the pot unable to
pay for the oracle's request.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: expire
docs: Anyone: rolls over a draw that can't go on (nobody won it, or its claims ended).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: launch
docs: Creates the launch through the launchpad, the creator address signing as its creator. The
remaining accounts are `create_launch`'s.

instructions.name: release
docs: Anyone: sends the beneficiary the dev bag's vested tokens.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: retire
docs: Anyone: sends the pot of a game that has paid no prize for two dormant periods to the
buyback, paying nobody.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Anyone: stores the oracle's answer; the claim windows start.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: set_hook_status
docs: The protocol's upgrade authority: whether a game hook is audited, its pots' cap while not,
and whether it is blocked.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority (the protocol's), paying the rent the first time.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: What the protocol says of `hook`, made the first time.

instructions.name: share
docs: Anyone: streams the holders' part to holders through the kit.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Anyone: pays the beneficiary their part as SOL.

errors.name: BadSplit
errors.msg: the split must add up to 10,000 basis points

errors.name: BountyTooHigh
errors.msg: the bounty is at most 1% of what a step moves

errors.name: BadBuybackLimits
errors.msg: buybacks need a cap above zero and at least a minute between them

errors.name: VestTooLong
errors.msg: a dev bag vests over a year at most

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account the step needs was not passed

errors.name: WrongCreator
errors.msg: the launch's creator must be this companion's creator address

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the launch's mint must be this companion's mint

errors.name: AlreadyLaunched
errors.msg: this companion has launched already

errors.name: NotLaunched
errors.msg: this companion has not launched yet

errors.name: CreatorLockUnsupported
errors.msg: a companion launch can't use the creator wallet lock: the companion's own vesting replaces it

errors.name: HolderRewardsOff
errors.msg: a share for holders needs holder rewards on

errors.name: CustomHookUnsupported
errors.msg: a companion launch can't use a custom token hook unless it runs that hook's game

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: nothing to do yet

errors.name: BuybackNotDue
errors.msg: too early: the next buyback is not due yet

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: Underfunded
errors.msg: the creator address must keep its rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: AuthorShareUnsupported
errors.msg: a companion launch can't come from a listed config that pays an author

errors.name: BeneficiaryNotAWallet
errors.msg: with holder rewards on, the beneficiary must be a wallet (the dev bag can only go to one)

errors.name: DevBuyWindowClosed
errors.msg: the dev's buy is made within ten minutes of the launch

errors.name: DevBagOverMaxWallet
errors.msg: the dev bag would hold more than max wallet allows a wallet before graduation

errors.name: EarlyLocked
errors.msg: tokens bought in the early-buyer window stay until it unlocks

errors.name: NoQuote
errors.msg: the pool can't quote a buyback right now

errors.name: OracleAccount
errors.msg: an account of the randomness oracle is not the one expected

errors.name: OracleFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: the randomness oracle's fee is above the most a draw pays

errors.name: OracleNotFulfilled
errors.msg: the randomness oracle has not answered yet

errors.name: OracleFulfilled
errors.msg: the randomness oracle has answered: reveal the draw

errors.name: BadGame
errors.msg: a game's settings are out of bounds

errors.name: NotAGame
errors.msg: this companion runs no game

errors.name: GameHookMismatch
errors.msg: a game coin's launch must use the game's hook, with the callbacks a lottery needs

errors.name: HookState
errors.msg: the game hook's state is not the one expected (owner, address, magic, mint or round length)

errors.name: HookRegistry
errors.msg: the game hook's registry is not the one expected

errors.name: HookStatusAccount
errors.msg: the hook status account is not the one expected

errors.name: NotProtocolAuthority
errors.msg: only the protocol's upgrade authority sets a hook's status

errors.name: BadHookStatus
errors.msg: an audit is final, an audited hook can't be blocked, a blocked hook is unblocked only by an audit, and a hook not audited is capped at 0.1 to 10 SOL

errors.name: DrawPending
errors.msg: a draw is in progress

errors.name: NoDraw
errors.msg: no draw is at this step

errors.name: RoundNotOver
errors.msg: the round is not over, or has been drawn already

errors.name: PotTooSmall
errors.msg: the pot is below the game's minimum

errors.name: AttemptClosed
errors.msg: this attempt's claim window is not open

errors.name: NotTheWinner
errors.msg: this holding does not hold the drawn ticket

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: this owner can't win: the launch, its pool, the creator address, or an address off the curve

errors.name: WrongHolding
errors.msg: the holding is not the one expected

errors.name: NotDue
errors.msg: too early for this step

errors.name: DrawLate
errors.msg: too late: a draw's claims end with the round after the drawn one

errors.name: TooManyHookExtras
errors.msg: a game hook's registry lists more extra accounts than a launch transaction can carry

errors.name: OracleUnanswered
errors.msg: the oracle has not answered the last request the pot paid for: the pot pays for a new one only after a backoff

errors.name: GameHookNotAccepted
errors.msg: a game's hook must be Bordrless's lottery hook, or one the protocol has given a status, and not blocked

errors.name: HookNotBlocked
errors.msg: only a blocked game hook's stranded buyback can be burned

errors.name: StaleSeed
errors.msg: a draw's seed comes from one of the last 3 slots, which ORAO has not answered: build the draw again from a newer slot

types.name: BuybackWaited
docs: A buyback that waited: the price was above the reference (which moved toward it, when due).

types.name: Companion
docs: `PDA(["companion", mint])`.

fields.name: creator_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["creator", mint])`, the launch's creator.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Who launched it: receives the beneficiary's part of the fees and the vested dev bag.

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: What a step pays whoever sends it, of what it moves (at most `MAX_BOUNTY_BPS`).

fields.name: max_buyback
docs: The most one buyback spends (lamports of bridged SOL).

fields.name: buyback_interval
docs: The least time between buybacks.

fields.name: vest_secs
docs: The dev bag vests linearly over this many seconds from the launch (0: at once).

fields.name: dev_tokens
docs: Tokens bought for the dev bag, and released to the beneficiary so far.

fields.name: pending_buyback
docs: Bridged SOL held for each purpose (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Running totals.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: The buyback's reference price (quote per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`), set at the launch and
moved toward the pool's price by at most `REFERENCE_STEP_BPS` at a time, once an interval.

fields.name: game_hook
docs: The game's token hook (`create_game`); the default key for a companion without a game.

fields.name: pot_bps
docs: The pot's part of every fee claim, next to `split` (the four sum to 10,000).

fields.name: pending_pot
docs: Bridged SOL held for the game's pot (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: round_secs
docs: The game's round length, which its hook's header must state (checked at the launch).

fields.name: stranded_burned_at
docs: When `burn_stranded` last burned a blocked game's buyback, a blocked game's pot last moved
into the buyback (by any step: `enforce_terms`), or a blocked game's fee claim last credited
the buyback at least what it held (`Companion::restart_stranded_wait`) (0: never): the
next burn waits its whole period from here, so a pot moved, or a share credited to a
buyback that had spent what it was given, is never burned before keepers have had that
long to spend it.

types.name: CreateArgs
docs: Arguments of `create`.

fields.name: max_buyback
docs: The most one buyback spends, lamports (ignored without a buyback share).

fields.name: buyback_interval
docs: The least time between buybacks, seconds.

fields.name: vest_secs
docs: The dev bag vests over this many seconds from the launch.

fields.name: fund
docs: Lamports for the creator address: the launch's fee and rent (it pays them as the launch's
creator) and its own rent-exempt minimum, which it keeps.

types.name: CreateGameArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_game`.

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's token hook (game ticket standard v1), already prepared for the mint with
`round_secs`; the launch's config must name it.

fields.name: split
docs: Every fee claim's split, with the pot's part: the four sum to 10,000. No holders' part: a
game coin has its own hook, so no kit.

fields.name: round_secs
docs: An hour to 30 days, as the hook's header says.

fields.name: min_pot
docs: No draw while the pot holds less (0.1 to 1,000 SOL).

fields.name: prize_bps
docs: The part of the pot one draw pays (10% to 100%).

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: How long each claim attempt is open (5 minutes to a day).

fields.name: max_attempts
docs: Attempts per draw (1 to 16); all of them within half a round (`max_attempts *
claim_window_secs <= round_secs / 2`), so a draw made early in the round after its own
keeps every attempt before its claims end.

types.name: CreateLaunchArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_launch`.

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee in basis points of the quote, at most the config's maximum. With a
`LaunchConfig` it must equal the config's.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve the curve opens with (sets the opening market cap), within the
config's bounds.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, within the config's bounds; fixed at launch. With a `LaunchConfig` they
must equal the config's.

types.name: DrawCommitted
docs: A draw committed its seed, made from the hash of one of the last `oracle::SEED_SLOTS` slots, so
nobody could know its answer: always with its request (`DrawRequested`, the same instruction).

fields.name: total
docs: The round's ticket total, read from the hook's header.

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round.

fields.name: request
docs: The oracle's request account for the seed.

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot whose hash is in the seed (the draw named it).

types.name: DrawRequested
docs: A draw's seed requested from the oracle, in the instruction that committed it (or a pending
request someone had already made for it adopted: then nothing is paid).

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round.

fields.name: request
docs: The oracle's request account, where the randomness will be.

fields.name: made
docs: Whether the companion made the request (else it adopted one ORAO already held).

fields.name: fee
docs: The oracle's fee, and what the pot sent the oracle payer for this request.

fields.name: paid_streak
docs: Requests the pot has paid for since ORAO last answered one of this game's, this one
included (`Game.paid_streak`): above 1, the last one was still unanswered.

fields.name: prize
docs: What the draw will pay.

types.name: DrawRevealed
docs: The oracle answered: the draw's randomness, from which every attempt's ticket follows.

types.name: DrawStatus
docs: Where a game's draw is.

types.name: Game
docs: `PDA(["game", mint])`: a companion's game (`create_game`), its settings fixed before the launch,
and its draw. The pot itself is `Companion.pending_pot` (bridged SOL in the creator's holding).

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's token hook, which keeps the tickets (game ticket standard v1).

fields.name: state_bump
docs: Bumps of the hook's `["state", mint]`, of `["hook-status", hook]` and of `["oracle", mint]`.

fields.name: round_secs
docs: Rounds are `floor(unix_time / round_secs)`, as the hook's header says.

fields.name: min_pot
docs: No draw while the pot holds less.

fields.name: prize_bps
docs: The part of the pot one draw pays.

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: How long each attempt's claim is open.

fields.name: max_attempts
docs: Attempts per draw before the round rolls over.

fields.name: next_round
docs: The earliest round the next draw may be for (every earlier one is drawn or rolled over).

fields.name: round
docs: The round of the current (or last) draw, and its ticket total, read from the hook's header.

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round, part of its derivation: always 0. A round has one seed,
which is final (never replaced while the draw lasts, however late ORAO answers).

fields.name: seed
docs: The draw's seed and the oracle's request account for it (`oracle::request_address(seed)`),
committed and requested together, by `draw`, at `committed_at` (`requested_at`, the same).

fields.name: randomness
docs: The revealed randomness, and when.

fields.name: prize
docs: What this draw pays (fixed at the request: `prize_bps` of the pot then).

fields.name: oracle_total
docs: Lamports the pot has sent the oracle payer.

fields.name: settled_at
docs: When the pot last paid a prize or was retired to the buyback (0: never, and the launch
counts): a pot that pays nothing for long is dormant (`Game::dormant_secs`), then
retirable (`Game::retirable_at`).

fields.name: paid_seed
docs: The seed of the last request the pot paid for, until a draw is revealed (zeros: none). While
ORAO has not answered it (still pending, in a form this program can't read, or gone), the
pot pays for no new request until `Game::oracle_backoff_rounds` rounds after its draw's.

fields.name: paid_round
docs: The round of that request's draw.

fields.name: paid_streak
docs: Requests the pot has paid for since ORAO last answered one of this game's (a reveal, or
the last paid request found answered).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for the kinds to come (their settings and state), zero until then.

types.name: GameCreated
docs: A game made for a companion before its launch (`create_game`): its split now includes the pot.

fields.name: first_round
docs: The first round a draw may be for.

types.name: GameKind
docs: The kinds of game a companion runs. Borsh writes the variant's index, so a kind added later
(a last-buyer jackpot, a holding streak) is appended and every game made before keeps its own.

types.name: HookStatus
docs: What the protocol says of a game hook, `PDA(["hook-status", hook])`, written only by the
companion program's upgrade authority (`set_hook_status`). Without one, a hook is not audited,
its pots are capped at `DEFAULT_POT_CAP` and it is not blocked.

fields.name: audited
docs: Audited with the companion: its pots are not capped (and it is never blocked).

fields.name: pot_cap
docs: The most each pot of this hook's games holds while it is not audited.

fields.name: blocked
docs: The pot share of every game of this hook, and every pot, go to the buyback: no prize is
paid. Only for a hook that is not audited; an audit clears it.

types.name: HookStatusArgs
docs: Arguments of `set_hook_status`.

fields.name: audited
docs: Audited with the companion: its games' pots are not capped. Clears a block. Final: an
audited hook stays audited (so it can never be blocked).

fields.name: pot_cap
docs: The most each of its games' pots holds while it is not audited: `MIN_POT_CAP` (0.1 SOL)
to `DEFAULT_POT_CAP` (10 SOL). Not read once audited.

fields.name: blocked
docs: Its games' pot share and pots go to the buyback, and no prize is paid. Only for a hook
that is not audited.

types.name: HookStatusSet
docs: The protocol set what it says of a game hook.

types.name: Launch
docs: A launch at `["launch", mint]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who launched it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool on the DEX.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote mint.

fields.name: status
docs: `STATUS_CURVE` or `STATUS_GRADUATED`.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: LP fee of the pool.

fields.name: sniper_window_secs
docs: Sniper window.

fields.name: sniper_start_bps
docs: LP fee at the start of the window.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve at opening.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base reserve.

fields.name: graduation_quote
docs: Real quote reserve at which the launch graduates.

fields.name: curve_tokens
docs: Tokens on the curve.

fields.name: reserve_tokens
docs: Tokens reserved for graduation.

fields.name: reserve_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the token (the reserve, then nothing).

fields.name: quote_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the quote (creator fees).

fields.name: lp_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the pool's LP mint (locked for ever).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Graduation time (0 until then).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Creator fees taken so far.

fields.name: creator_fees_claimed
docs: Creator fees claimed so far.

fields.name: graduation_topup
docs: Base added to the pool at graduation.

fields.name: graduation_burned
docs: Base burned at graduation.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

fields.name: modules
docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: PotFunded
docs: A fee claim's pot share (game companions only, next to `FeesClaimed`): what the pot got, and
what went to the buyback instead (above the cap of a hook that is not audited, or all of it
for a blocked hook).

types.name: PotRetired
docs: A pot that had paid no prize for two dormant periods (`retire`) sent to the buyback: nobody is
paid it. The game goes on.

fields.name: idle_since
docs: Since when the pot had paid nothing (its last prize or retirement, or the launch).

types.name: PotToBuyback
docs: Pot money moved to the buyback: the pot of a blocked hook's game, or what a pot held above a cap
lowered since. Moved by `burn_stranded`, it waits a whole stranded period before any burn.

types.name: PrizePaid
docs: A draw paid its winner.

fields.name: prize
docs: Paid to the winner as SOL, and to the sender.

types.name: RolledOver
docs: A round rolled over: the pot stays for the next draw (or, blocked, went to the buyback).

types.name: RolloverReason
docs: Why a round paid no prize.

types.name: Split
docs: What every creator fee claim pays for, in basis points summing to 10,000.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Bought back on the token's own pool and burned.

fields.name: holders_bps
docs: Streamed to holders through the kit's reward pool.

fields.name: beneficiary_bps
docs: Accrued to the beneficiary, who is paid it as SOL.

types.name: StrandedBurned
docs: A blocked game hook's buyback that no buy had spent for `STRANDED_SECS` (or `STRANDED_INTERVALS`
intervals) burned as SOL: unwrapped and sent to the incinerator. Nobody is paid, the sender
included. Never a pot the same call moved there: that is kept a whole wait (`PotToBuyback`).

fields.name: lamports
docs: Burned: the pending buyback (pots moved there by earlier steps included).

fields.name: since
docs: Since when no buyback had bought or waited (the latest of the launch, the last buyback,
the reference price's last move, the block, the last burn and the pot's move into the
buyback).
